content.value_statement: Marketing teams need content that stays consistent across channels. This skill helps plan, write, analyze, and optimize content for brand voice and SEO.
actual_capabilities: Analyze local text for readability, sentence variety, tone, perspective, and brand voice recommendations.
Score SEO content for keyword density, structure, readability, links, length, and meta tag suggestions.
Provide reusable frameworks for blog posts, case studies, listicles, landing pages, email, and video scripts.
Guide platform-specific social media formatting, hashtag use, accessibility checks, and compliance reminders.
Support monthly and weekly content planning with a reusable calendar template.
limitations: It does not perform live keyword-volume research or connect to SEO platforms.
It does not publish, schedule, or update content on external services.
SEO scoring is heuristic and should be reviewed against current search guidance.
Brand voice analysis depends on the quality and size of the sample text.

use_cases.title: Build a Brand Voice Baseline
use_cases.description: Analyze existing copy, define tone attributes, and create guidance for future marketing content.

use_cases.title: Optimize a Blog Draft
use_cases.description: Check keyword use, structure, readability, links, and metadata before publication.

use_cases.title: Plan Social Content
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign theme into platform-ready posts and schedule ideas for the month.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Blog Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a blog outline for [topic]. Include audience, primary keyword, sections, and a clear call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Match Brand Voice
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for adapting draft copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this draft for [brand voice]. Keep the message, improve clarity, and list the voice choices you applied.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose for Social Channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this article into posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook. Match each platform format and audience intent.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Campaign Content Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this monthly content plan for brand consistency, SEO coverage, platform fit, compliance, accessibility, and measurable goals.

output_examples.input: A draft article about project management software with the keyword "team planning tools".
output: SEO score with content length, keyword density, headings, links, and readability notes.
Meta title, meta description, URL slug, and specific recommendations for stronger search relevance.

output_examples.input: A short product announcement that needs social media versions.
output: A LinkedIn post with professional context and a clear discussion prompt.
A short X post, an Instagram caption, and Facebook copy with platform-specific length and tone.

output_examples.input: Three samples from a company blog and a request for a brand voice baseline.
output: A voice profile covering formality, tone, perspective, readability, and sentence variety.
Practical recommendations for keeping future content consistent with the observed style.

best_practices: Start with audience need, search intent, and one measurable goal before drafting.
Use the brand voice analyzer on representative samples before writing for a new brand.
Review SEO recommendations manually so keywords support clarity instead of replacing it.
anti_patterns: Do not publish content only because it reaches a high SEO score.
Do not reuse one social post unchanged across every platform.
Do not infer a full brand voice from one short sample.

faq.question: Does this skill write complete articles?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide article structure, drafting, optimization, and editing when you provide the topic and audience.

faq.question: Can it analyze existing brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled analyzer reviews local text for readability, tone signals, perspective, sentence variety, and improvement suggestions.

faq.question: Does it connect to SEO tools?
faq.answer: No. It uses local heuristic analysis and does not fetch keyword volume, rankings, or live search data.

faq.question: Can it create social media content?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes platform guidance for adapting messages, hashtags, length, accessibility, and compliance.

faq.question: Is it useful for content calendars?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a calendar template and planning guidance for campaign themes, weekly distribution, and content pillars.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should verify facts, legal claims, brand approvals, accessibility, search intent, and platform-specific requirements.
